title: Choose the payment option that’s right for you.

sections.title: Our best price
sections.text: You will be asked to provide a valid payment instrument, in order to complete the booking.
bullets: Book with confidence: change or cancel free within 24 hours of booking when your pickup is more than 48 hours away. After 24 hours, adjust or cancel anytime before pickup for a fee.
Cancellation fees are based on your final selection and will be displayed on the page where you finalize your booking.
If you cancel after the scheduled pickup time, no refund will be given.

sections.title: Stay flexible
sections.text: You’ll pay for the vehicle when you pick it up.
